body.p: The Office Action issued on November 18, 2024, has been received and its contents carefully considered. Claim 1 is the independent claim, and claims 1-4 and 6-12 remain pending in the application. For at least the following reasons, it is submitted that this application is in condition for allowance.
Claims 1-4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Yu et al. (CN 106695777) ("Yu").
Claims 7 and 11 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Yu as applied to claim 1, in view of Geiger (WO 202123833) ("Geiger").
The Applicant respectfully traverse the rejection of claim 1. Claim 1 recites:
a plurality of modules that are coupled together, wherein each of the plurality
of modules includes:
a first link;
a second link movably linked to the first link; and
a liquid pressure cylinder configured to move the first link and the second link
relative to each other by a working fluid that is supplied to a cylinder chamber from a
liquid pressure source located outside the plurality of modules and is discharged
from the cylinder chamber to a tank located outside the plurality of modules, wherein
the first link includes a cylinder block in which the cylinder chamber of the
liquid pressure cylinder is formed, the cylinder block having a plurality of outer
surfaces, and at least two of the plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block each
have both a pump port connectable to the liquid pressure source and a tank port
connectable to the tank.
(emphasis added)

The Examiner has pointed out that elements 21 and 32 in Yu correspond to "first link" of claim 1, elements 1-9 and 22-24 in Yu correspond to "second link" of claim 1, and elements 42 and 40 in Yu correspond to "liquid pressure cylinder" of claim 1.
However, in Yu, the element 21 is not movably linked to elements 22-24, and the
element 32 is not movably linked to elements 1-9. That is, the elements 1-9 are not movably linked to the element 32 and the elements 22-24 are not movably linked to the element 21 in Yu.
Further, the arm cylinder 42 in Yu does not move the element 21 and elements 22-24 relative to each other, but moves main arm plate 36 relative to the element 21. Furthermore,

the shoulder joint cylinder 40 in Yu does not move the element 32 and the elements 1-9 relative to each other, but moves the element 32 relative to the main arm plate 36 ("the main arm plate (36) is provided with a shoulder hydraulic cylinder (40), a shoulder connecting block (21) and a main arm plate (36) for driving the wrist connecting block (32) to rotate relative to the main arm plate (36) (42) for driving the main arm plate (36) to rotate relative to the shoulder connecting block (21)" (claim 6 of Yu)). Accordingly, Yu does not teach or suggest the claimed "first link," "second link," and "liquid pressure cylinder," as recited in claim 1.

Moreover, the Examiner has pointed out that in Yu's elements 21 and 32, which correspond to the "first link" of claim 1, have the cylinder block 37. However, as clearly understood from FIG. 2 of Yu, the element 21 does not include the cylinder block 37; instead, arm cylinder 42 includes the cylinder block 37, as Yu also recites in a claim 9: "the arm cylinder (42) comprises a hydraulic cylinder piston rod (35) and a hydraulic cylinder (37)". Therefore, Yu does not teach or suggest "the first link includes a cylinder block in which the cylinder chamber of the liquid pressure cylinder is formed."
Further, as clearly understood from FIG. 2 of Yu, Yu discloses that only one of the

plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block has both a pump port connectable to the liquid pressure source and a tank port connectable to the tank. Therefore, Yu fails to disclose "the cylinder block having a plurality of outer surfaces, and at least two of the plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block each have both a pump port connectable to the liquid pressure source and a tank port connectable to the tank," as recited in claim 1.
As stated in the Amendment filed on October 21, 2024, Geiger also does not teach or suggest all of the features recited in claim 1.
Accordingly, the cited references do not teach or suggest all of the features recited in

claim 1 and thus do not render claim 1 obvious. Claims 2-4 and 6-10 depend from claim 1 and are thus patentable over the cited references for at least the reasons advanced above as to the patentability of claim 1. Therefore, the rejection of claims 1-4 and 6-10 should be reconsidered and withdrawn.
Based on the above, it therefore is submitted that this application is in condition for

allowance and a notice to that effect is requested. Should the Examiner feel that a conference would help to expedite the prosecution of this application, the Examiner is hereby invited to contact the undersigned counsel to arrange for such an interview.
No fee is believed due. Should any fee be required, the Commissioner is hereby
authorized to charge the fee to our Deposit Account No. 18-0002, and is respectfully requested to advise us accordingly.
Respectfully submitted,
